events.title: Try Matelotes' demo during Steam Next Fest! 🌊
events.summary: Hi everyone, The cartographers of Sauzic may have failed to draw a map (for now), but we've got great news: Matelotes is part of Steam Next Fest! Set sail in our playable demo From October 19th, 7pm (UTC+2) to October 26th, you’ll be able to manage your crew, explore unknown lands, and test your strategic skills on the open sea. events.title: Announcing Matelotes
events.summary: Dive into a dice light-RPG driven by randomness, strategy and procedural generation!Ahoy sailors,Matelotes will be released in Early Access in 2027!So, why Early Access? We chose Early Access for Matelotes to have the best version possible in V1. And who is better to help in this task than you, sailors!Matelotes is a mix of strategic management and randomness.
